title: ShieldCare Excess: the Allowance a Managed Care Agreement Carries
content:
Where the profile holds a managed care agreement under Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair, an
allowance is taken off the excess on an approved claim under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan. The
care agreement read is the one standing scheduled on the profile, and the included visits it carries are
the visits its own term allows rather than the visits left on it.

| What the profile holds | The allowance for a managed care agreement |
| --- | --- |
| every other profile, including one holding a care agreement whose term carries fewer than 12 included visits | no allowance for a managed care agreement is allowed |
| a care agreement whose included visits run to 12 or more in its term, and no visit stands drawn on it inside the last 12 months | 30.00 |
| a care agreement whose included visits run to 12 or more in its term, and a visit stands drawn on it inside the last 12 months | 60.00 |

### Both sides of the visit count

The count that opens the two paying rows is the included visits the agreement's own term allows. An
agreement carrying exactly 12 included visits in its term is inside those rows; one carrying 11 is not, and
falls to the last row, where no allowance is allowed. Where no care agreement stands scheduled on the
profile at all, no allowance is allowed either. The visits left on the agreement do not enter the count:
an agreement whose term allows 18 included visits is inside the paying rows however few of them remain
undrawn.

### The combinations set out

| Included visits the agreement's term allows | A visit drawn inside the last 12 months | Allowance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 | no | none |
| 4 | yes | none |
| 9 | no | none |
| 18 | no | 30.00 |
| 18 | yes | 60.00 |
| no care agreement standing scheduled | not applicable | none |

Within the two paying rows the whole of the difference is whether a visit stands drawn inside the last 12
months: drawn, the allowance is 60.00; not drawn, it is 30.00. A visit drawn 13 months ago is outside that
time and leaves the allowance at 30.00.
